title: Astral House Arrest
content: Have any of you been under house arrest in Mall World? Don't know why that happens to me consistently. Thing is I am frequently in Mall World, but whenever I begin to become extremely lucid about my environment, then somehow I get the attention of some type of astral police, and they somehow capture me to the point in which forces my dreams to end. Once I am in my astral house, I begin to experience weird nightmarish experiences. I am still in Mall World, but I get tortured in the process through some type of electric shocks, forced false awakening loops that never ends, and astral body paralysis which causes me to see weird things that looked like AI art. As much as I enjoy Mall World, for some reason I am not allowed to get too lucid.
